name: Dodavahu
overview: Dodavahu was a male figure identified as being from Mareshah. He is noted primarily for his role as the father of Eliezer, recognized as a prophet in the biblical record. Beyond this, no additional tribal affiliation or notable personal details are provided.
namesAndTitles: The name Dodavahu means 'beloved of YHWH,' reflecting a meaningful theophoric element that honors the Lord. This proper name underscores a relationship of favor or affection from God, though the name was not given directly by God according to the record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Dodavahu as the father of Eliezer, who is identified as a prophet. No other family relationships are documented beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Dodavahu's significance lies chiefly in his connection to Eliezer, a prophetic figure in the biblical narrative. As the father of a prophet, Dodavahu is part of the lineage through which God’s messages were delivered. His identification with Mareshah situates him geographically, providing context within the historical setting of the events recorded.
